_comment: All in-game dialogue. Each entry: id, speaker, hindi text, optional 'voice' (a key in audio_map.json that resolves to an mp3), 'portrait' (sprite slot), and 'trigger' (intro|level_start|enemy|boss|ending|generic). Tone: warm and funny. Add lines freely; nothing here is hard-coded in engine code.

lines.speaker: Shefali
lines.text: Yeh duniya ko saaf rakhna meri zimmedari hai — aur thodi si meri hobby bhi!

lines.speaker: Shefali
lines.text: Main kisi ko maarungi nahi... bas meditation aur aura se inka dimaag theek karungi!

lines.speaker: Shefali
lines.text: Chalo Tea Post se shuru karte hain — pehle safai, phir kadak chai!

lines.speaker: Shefali
lines.text: Haye Ram, itna kachra! Lagta hai aaj overtime hai.

lines.speaker: Shefali
lines.text: Sabko theek kar doongi — ek bhi gandagi-wala nahi bachega!

lines.speaker: Shefali
lines.text: Baarish mein safai? Challenge accepted. Chai peeke baat karte hain!

lines.speaker: Litterer
lines.text: Plastic toh mera sachcha pyaar hai — har gali mein bikheraunga, aaha!

lines.speaker: Litterer
lines.text: Beach toh meri personal bathroom hai, beta!

lines.speaker: Litterer
lines.text: Main paryavaran ka Villain No.1 — pollution ka baadshah, haha!

lines.speaker: Litterer
lines.text: Paudhe? Ukhaad ke unki chai bana ke pee jaunga!

lines.speaker: Litterer
lines.text: Dustbin? Wo kaunsi nayi dish hai? Kabhi suna nahi!

lines.speaker: Litterer
lines.text: Recycle? Bhai main toh cycle bhi nahi chalata!

lines.speaker: Naya Dost
lines.text: Arre... ab dimaag ki batti jali! Sorry beta, ab se main bhi tree-planter!

lines.speaker: Chai Uncle
lines.text: Aao beti, ek kadak chai pee lo — energy full, tension null!

lines.speaker: Chai Uncle
lines.text: Pehle safai, phir chai — yeh Tea Post ka pukka niyam hai!

lines.speaker: Vaishnav
lines.text: Shefali kahan hai? Shefali kahan hai? Aji sunte ho!
